rawNotes: Mikko: 'google earth studio wont import .../earth-studio.esp' (real Earth Studio editor, exact on-screen error text not captured). Root cause identified independently: the v0.4 generator's .esp schema does not match the real Earth Studio project format (missing modelVersion/settings envelope, keyframe times in frames instead of duration fractions, un-normalized values, keyframes nested inside value, rotationX/rotationY semantics inverted). Reference: mkatzef/google-studio-utils esp_template.esp (modelVersion 17), whose generated files import successfully.
